# Compache

> A Python package that fits context compaction and prompt-cache policies to multi-turn chat and tool-call traces. The policy chooses what history remains visible, when a keep-warm request is worth sending, and which cache lifetime to request where supported.

Python 3.11+. Install with `python -m pip install compache`. `compache demo -o policy.json` fits a bundled sample locally without an API key. The repository documentation tracks its checkout. Use the documentation at the matching Git tag for an installed release.

## Integrate

- [Developer guide](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/guide.md) – start with a local demo, then fit, evaluate and apply.
- [Examples](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/examples/README.md) – run a wrapped chatbot against an in-memory provider or reproduce a held-out replay.
- [Integration guide](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/integrations.md) – choose an SDK wrapper, middleware, model-node transport or proxy. Keep the conversation's full history and pass a stable thread ID.
- [Application-managed sessions](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/sessions.md) – own prompt assembly, model calls, receipts, reopens and timers.
- [Coding agents](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/agents.md) – run a CLI through the proxy with `compache wrap` or observe with `--watch`.
- [Setup skill](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/skills/compache-setup/SKILL.md) – instructions for coding agents adding Compache to a project.

## Fit and verify

- [Trace inputs](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/traces.md) – explicit metadata-only recording, chat logs, trace imports and sampled labeling. Sampling can send conversation text to the model provider and incur charges.
- [Fitting and held-out evaluation](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/fitting.md) – train on whole conversations and replay on different threads. Measure dependencies before reopening and grade generated answers separately.
- [Reference](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/reference.md) – public CLI and Python entry points, return values and units.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md) – verify routing, diagnose retention and reconcile provider usage.
- [How the policy works](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md) – cost calculation, cache assumptions and limits.
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/BarendPotijk/compache/blob/main/benchmarks/README.md) – held-out estimates, live provider billing and answer quality.
- [Cost calculator](https://barendpotijk.github.io/compache/) – explore return-time, token and dependency assumptions in the browser.
